author: CyberAlchemy v2 security review working draft

statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-75595 requires Netty server-side TLS ClientHello/SNI selection. The candidate-backed application rehearsal enables Keycloak HTTP only, supplies no Keycloak HTTPS certificate or keystore, publishes no Keycloak port, and terminates TLS at the private Caddy proxy before forwarding plain HTTP to keycloak:8080. Changing any of those deployment facts invalidates this proposed statement. Security-owner acceptance is still required.

The candidate-backed application rehearsal fixes KC_DB to PostgreSQL and KC_DB_URL to a jdbc:postgresql endpoint, so the bundled Microsoft SQL Server driver is not selected or executed. The candidate SBOM also contains the fixed 13.2.1.jre11 classifier while Trivy reports the normalized 13.2.1 coordinate. Changing the database backend or URL invalidates this proposed statement. Security-owner acceptance is still required.

statements.status_notes: Trivy 0.74.0 retains this raw High finding with no fixed version. Red Hat's tracker records the CVE as officially rejected as bogus, and its Fedora OpenJDK child is closed NOTABUG; however, no security owner has accepted that vendor-status evidence as a candidate disposition. Keep the raw record visible and do not treat this proposal as a waiver.
